definitions.gloss: right of belligerency; right to wage war
definitions.explanation: The rights a state has under international law when it is at war. The term is best known from Article 9 of Japan's Constitution, which says the state's right of belligerency will not be recognized.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交戦権|こうせんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: The right of belligerency of the state is not recognized.

examples.japanese: ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧9{条|じょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交戦権|こうせんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}している→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧。
examples.english: Article 9 of the Constitution denies the right of belligerency.

examples.japanese: {交戦権|こうせんけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Even constitutional scholars disagree about what the right of belligerency refers to.

notes:
⟦{交戦|こうせん}→交戦：11724_kousen⟧ (engagement in battle) + 〜⟦{権|けん}→〜権：31354_ken⟧ (right).

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word is familiar to Japanese readers mainly from the last sentence of Article 9 of the Constitution: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交戦権|こうせんけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ ("The right of belligerency of the state will not be recognized"). It comes up whenever constitutional revision or the role of the Self-Defense Forces is debated.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{戦力|せんりょく}→戦力：18977_senryoku⟧: war potential; military forces (also in Article 9)
- {自衛権|じえいけん}: right of self-defense
